map.：草坪需水 8 L/㎡·次、每周 2 次、面积 1200 ㎡ → 单次用水 96: : The lawn needs 8 L/m2 per application, twice a week, over an area of 1200 m2 -> 9600 L per application and 19200 L per week; skip and postpone when the day's rain probability exceeds 60%, avoiding root rot and waste.
map.：乔木 15 L/株·次（每周 1 次）、灌木 6 L/株·次（每周 2 次），: : Trees 15 L per plant per application (once a week), shrubs 6 L per plant per application (twice a week); 80 trees + 200 shrubs -> 1200 + 2400 = 3600 L per week, scheduled in separate time slots from the lawn to avoid pipe network overpressure.

map.怎么判断某天要不要浇？: How do you decide whether to water on a given day?
map.看当日降雨概率与土壤墒情：概率高或刚下过雨则跳过；连续晴热且墒情低才按计划浇，避: Check the day's rain probability and soil moisture: skip when the probability is high or it has just rained; water as planned only after continuous hot, clear weather with low moisture, avoiding waterlogging and wasted water.
map.不同植被能共用一张排程吗？: Can different vegetation share one schedule?
map.不能，草坪、乔木、灌木的需水量与频次差异很大，应分类型排程并分别计算工作量。: No. Lawns, trees and shrubs differ greatly in water need and frequency; schedule by type and calculate the workload separately.
